steps: Recompute all checkpoint-bound widths directly from M41 INT8 payloads and M72 centers.
Rebuild packed and 32-byte-aligned start-word streams for all 1,728 phases.
Encode and decode every eligible and escape descriptor using the r2 16-bit field allocation.
Recompute both capacity variants and compare every field against r2 and frozen r1.
Recheck the eight r1 overflow counterexamples and the retained admission boundary.

descriptor_fix_closure.assessment: The reserved bit was correctly reassigned as start_word[12]. Both variants now have ample 13-bit address capacity and no storage-format side effect.

capacity_and_traffic_invariance.interpretation: The repair changes only descriptor meaning. It does not change descriptor bytes, payload layout, macro depth, catalog capacity, or traffic. WORD_PACKED remains the clear capacity choice.

p0_reassessment.remaining_gaps: All remaining gaps concern RTL timing/queues, physical macro realization, energy, performance scope, or system evidence and remain P1 rather than arithmetic/addressability blockers.

retained_r1_bank_evidence.interpretation: The offset field extension does not alter any packed word address. The r1 independently enumerated bank-request digest remains applicable.

newly_admitted: Both WORD_PACKED and ENTRY_ALIGNED start-word streams fit the concrete 16-bit r2 descriptor
The eight r1 aligned overflow counterexamples are fully closed
Descriptor capacity closure has zero byte, capacity, and traffic delta
still_admitted: Exact packed/aligned phase layout and capacity envelopes
Single-PWP conflict-free mapping for eight independently addressed 32-bit banks
M81 reversal from M80 -72.61 percent to exact packed +18.75 percent capacity envelope
not_admitted: accuracy, full-network/system performance, DATE, or best-paper headline

p1.finding: Conflict freedom still assumes eight independently addressed 32-bit banks; 75.83 percent of packed beats use base and base+1 rows across different banks.
p1.impact: A shared-row 256-bit macro cannot preserve the modeled one-cycle beat.
p1.minimal_fix: Instantiate and assert eight independent row addresses in VCS and map them to actual SRAM macros.

p1.finding: The base/base+1 selectors, final-word mask, and eight-word barrel reorder still have no latency, area, timing, or energy charge.
p1.impact: Common-path cross-row logic may limit frequency or erase part of the memory-energy benefit.
p1.minimal_fix: Pipeline and synthesize the complete read/reorder path with workload-linked SAIF/PTPX.

p1.finding: Descriptor rate sufficiency is not a finite-queue proof for synchronous SRAM responses, PWP transitions, arbitration, accumulator backpressure, or buffer swaps.
p1.impact: The inherited 3/4/4/5-cycle service remains an optimistic envelope.
p1.minimal_fix: Replay frozen descriptor/bank requests in VCS with ready/valid assertions and randomized backpressure.

p1.finding: Packed +18.75 percent uses exact 460-row banks; realizable 464/512 envelopes fall to +18.06/+9.72 percent, and aligned 576 rows is 1.39 percent larger than fixed12.
p1.impact: Capacity merit depends materially on selected compiler macros and cannot use the exact envelope as physical area evidence.
p1.minimal_fix: Choose actual macros with ECC/spares/periphery and report implemented total area and energy.

p1.finding: The descriptor repair and staging layout do not change PWP service cycles or catalog traffic; M81 still models only one PWP stream.
p1.impact: M81 is a capacity-feasibility contribution, not an additional accelerator speedup over M78.
p1.minimal_fix: Keep capacity and throughput claims separate and use equal-resource RTL measurements for any performance claim.

p1.finding: VCS closure, DC/Formality/STA/SAIF/PTPX, macro energy, accuracy, and full-system integration remain absent.
p1.impact: The descriptor P0 is closed, but DATE-level hardware evidence is not.
p1.minimal_fix: Complete packed 464/512-row RTL and Synopsys A/B, then propagate measured cycles and energy into the full-network simulator.

score_interpretation: r2 cleanly closes the only arithmetic/addressability P0 with a minimal and capacity-neutral field change. Evidence and milestone scores improve, while innovation and performance scores remain unchanged because no RTL, PPA, or cycle advantage was added.

go: GO for both layout formats as valid addressable DSE points under the r2 descriptor.
GO for WORD_PACKED as the preferred RTL path because its capacity envelopes dominate ENTRY_ALIGNED.
GO for 464/512-row macro-aware VCS and Synopsys implementation.
no_go: NO-GO for treating ENTRY_ALIGNED as capacity-competitive without a specific implementation reason.
NO-GO for zero-bubble, physical +18.75 percent, power, energy, or new speedup claims.
NO-GO for DATE/best-paper promotion until remaining P1 evidence closes.

next_gate.name: M81B word-packed VCS and macro-aware Synopsys closure
must_include: 13-bit start_word assertions on parser output and runtime lookup
eight independently addressed banks and barrel reorder RTL
464/512-row macro packing including ECC and periphery
capacity and inherited M78 speedup reported separately
